crop.notes: Ten-piece clipping of a whole column (bicycle races, gun club, Illinois rifle, Hanlan, wool-growers, Board of Health, ads, Kansas City embezzlers); the Allen item is only the short 'Sporting Notes' notice at the bottom of crop-3.

ocr.notes: Allen notice reads correctly; surrounding items have scattered errors.

title.suggested: Allen Advertises Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat again carried a notice for Tom Allen, "retired champion pugilist of the world," at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert every evening with only the best singers engaged.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Saturday Morning, September 17, 1892.

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening and billing himself as retired champion pugilist of the world

notes: Same notice as article 858 (Sept 3, 1892). Crop could be trimmed to the Allen notice.
